content: रन्ध्रम् [<ls>Uṇ. 2. 28</ls>] .²1 A hole, an aperture, a cavity, an opening, a chasm, fissure; रन्ध्रष्विवालक्ष्यनभःप्रदेशा <ls>R. 13. 56</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 82</ls>; नासाग्ररन्ध्रम् <ls>Māl. 1. 1</ls>; क्रौञ्चरन्ध्रम् <ls>Me. 59</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) A weak or vulnerable point, assailable point; रन्ध्रोपनिपातिनोऽनर्थाः <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; रन्ध्रान्वेषणदक्षाणां द्विषामामिषतां ययौ <ls>R. 12. 11</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 17</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 61</ls>; रन्ध्रं च प्रकृतीनाम् <ls>Kau. A. 1. 16</ls>. .³({%b%}) A defect, fault, an imperfection. .²3 A symbolical expression for the number ‘nine’, (there being nine openings in the human body). .²4 The vulva. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the 8th astrological mansion; <ls>Bṛ. S.</ls> .²6 A mischief; रन्ध्रदर्शनासहैः <ls>Dk. 2. 7</ls>.
